;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present)]], [[American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021)]], Aftermath of the [[Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad]], [[Assassination of Qasem Soleimani]]
**[[Popular Mobilization Forces]] spokesman [[Ahmed Al Asadi]] confirms the death of [[Quds Force]] Commander [[Qasem Soleimani]] in an airstrike, blaming [[Israel]] and the [[United States]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/irans-major-general-qassem-soleimani-and-iraqs-muhandis-killed-in-air-strike-militia-spokesman/articleshow/73077547.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
**United States officials say "strikes have been carried out against two targets linked to Iran in [[Baghdad]]".  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-usa-strike/strikes-against-two-targets-linked-to-iran-u-s-officials-idUSKBN1Z201Q (Reuters)]
**In response to the death of Qasem Soleimani, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] [[Twitter|tweets]] an image of an [[Flag of the United States|American flag]]. He later defends the airstrike, claiming Soleimani "was both hated and feared" in Iran and "should have been taken out many years ago." [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/476610-trump-tweets-american-flag-amid-reports-of-strike-against-iranian (''The Hill'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/trump-tweets-after-u-s-strike-iran-never-won-war-n1109906 (NBC News)]
**The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] says Soleimani and Muhandis were "[[Martyrs in Islam|martyred]]" in an attack by U.S. [[Attack helicopter|helicopter]]s. Anonymous security sources cited by [[Agence France-Presse|AFP]] say the attack killed at least eight people. The Iraqi military says three rockets hit the airport and two cars exploded. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2020/01/552980/update-8-killed-rocket-attack-baghdad-airport (''New Straits Times'')]
**The secretary of the Iranian [[Expediency Discernment Council]], former [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] commander [[Mohsen Rezaee]], tweets that "vigorous revenge against America" will be pursued following the assassination of Soleimani. [[Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting|Iranian state television]] cuts all broadcasts, replacing them with [[Islamic prayer|prayer]]s for Soleimani. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-blast-rezaei/former-iran-guards-chief-vows-vigorous-revenge-against-america-for-soleimani-killing-idUSKBN1Z205Q (Reuters)] [https://www.rawstory.com/2020/01/iran-state-tv-cuts-broadcasts-and-is-just-showing-photos-of-assassinated-general-qasem-soleimani/ (''The Raw Story'')]
**[[Brigadier general|Brigadier-General]] [[Esmail Ghaani]] is appointed as the new commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' Quds Force, replacing Qassem Soleimani. [https://www.newsweek.com/1qassem-soleimani-esmail-ghaani-appointed-us-drone-strike-1480225 (''Newsweek'')]
**The [[Supreme Leader of Iran]] [[Marja'|Grand Ayatollah]] [[Ali Khamenei]] declares three days of [[national mourning]] in [[Iran]]. [https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/443691/Iran-announces-three-days-of-national-mourning-for-Gen-Soleimani (''Tehran Times'')]
**The [[United States]] sends over 3,000 more [[United States Armed Forces|US soldiers]] to the [[Middle East]] as tensions with [[Iran]] heighten. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/military/u-s-sending-thousands-more-troops-mideast-after-baghdad-attack-n1110081 (NBC News)]
**[[United States Department of Homeland Security|Homeland security]] warns of potential attacks from Iranian backed militias or any other potential threat. Police been put on high alert due to such threats. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/04/politics/dhs-cyber-security-warning-iran/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Taji road airstrike]]
**An airstrike hits a [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] convoy near [[camp Taji]], destroying two vehicles, killing six militia members and critically injuring three others, according to an [[Iraqi Army]] source. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-blast-taji/air-strikes-targeting-iraqi-militia-kill-six-army-source-idUSKBN1Z229P (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The death toll of an attack that occurred on 22 December 2019 rises from 14 to 50 after more bodies are found in [[Lake Chad]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50987123 (BBC News)]
*[[Communal conflicts in Nigeria]]
**Gunmen kill 19 in [[Kogi State]] of [[Nigeria]]. A church, a school and other buildings are torched. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/unidentified-gunmen-kill-19-people-central-nigeria-200103170749713.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A man stabs three people in [[Villejuif]], [[Île-de-France]], killing one person and wounding two others. The attacker is shot dead by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50986028 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Jakarta floods]]
**The death toll of the floods in [[Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]], that started two days ago rises to 43. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50981453 (BBC News)]
*A [[Harbin Y-12]] [[Cargo_aircraft#Light_aircraft|light transport aircraft]] crashes near [[Haputale]], [[Sri Lanka]]. All four people on board, members of the [[Sri Lanka Air Force]], are killed. [http://www.adaderana.lk/news/59999/four-air-force-personnel-killed-in-aircraft-crash-at-haputale (Ada Derana)]
;Law and crime
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]], [[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]]
**The Spanish [[Junta Electoral Central|Central Electoral Bureau]] ceases in the position of [[Parliament of Catalonia|deputy]] to [[Quim Torra]], and therefore, also that of [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia]] in compliance with the non-definitive conviction of the [[High Court of Justice of Catalonia|Catalan High Court of Justice]]. At the same time, withdraws immunity as [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] to jailed [[Oriol Junqueras]] that recognized the [[European Court of Justice]] on 19 December 2019. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3044652/catalan-president-quim-torra-ousted-office-spanish-electoral (''South China Morning Post'')]
**This decision prompts protests in [[Barcelona]]. Torra, in a special press conference after the meeting of Catalan cabinet, calls the decision "a [[coup d'état]] against Catalan institutions" while an extraordinary session of the [[Catalan Parliament]] is summoned for 4 January. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/spains-electoral-board-orders-catalan-211944185.html (Yahoo! News)]
